claim: main-v3 refactored the agent role surface. The new canonical set is 9 roles (setup, splitter, designer, coder, evaluator, judge, selector, reviser, aggregator) instead of v2's 8 (setup, designer, judge, coder, tuner, reviser, aggregator, manager). Three roles were removed (tuner, manager, plus one absorbed elsewhere) and three were added (splitter, evaluator, selector).

model_injection_simplification.v2: 8 occurrences of config.model in agents.py (one per build_*_opts site)
model_injection_simplification.v3: 1 occurrence of config.model in engine/options.py:build_agent_spec (single source of truth)

scope: Schema / surface fact, not a routing recommendation. Documents which historical evidence cards still apply unchanged vs which need scope tags vs which are obsolete on v3.
limitations: We have not yet measured cost / quality for splitter / evaluator / selector — they are pristine roles in the routing memory.

The relationship between v2's 'tuner' work and v3's 'coder + reviser' or 'evaluator' is fuzzy. The v3 architecture likely folded hyperparameter exploration into the coder loop and added evaluator as a separate quality gate. Until we have v3 runs in index.jsonl, the v2 tuner-cost-share insight (E002) is preserved as legacy-only context.

implications_for_existing_evidence.E001 (haiku on detecting-insults): Still valid. All roles haiku — model-level claim, role-surface-independent.
implications_for_existing_evidence.E002 (tuner=54% / coder=31% of cost): Legacy-only. tuner does not exist on v3. Cost-share for v3 must be re-measured.
implications_for_existing_evidence.E004 (opus bridges medal tier on hard ta: Still valid scope, but localization-by-role discussion needs re-grounding (no tuner on v3).
implications_for_existing_evidence.E005 (manager = $0 in accounting): Obsolete. manager does not exist on v3.
implications_for_existing_evidence.E008 (X002 tuner-opus-alone fails): Legacy-only. Re-design experiments for v3 role mix (e.g. opus-on-coder vs opus-on-evaluator).

next_actions: When first v3 run lands in index.jsonl: recompute role_cost_share_pct (E002 successor for v3).
Design v3-native experiments: opus-on-coder, opus-on-evaluator, opus-on-judge — these are the roles likely to gate medal tier on hard tasks.
Consider whether splitter should always be cheap (haiku) — it's deterministic splitting work.
